mapper.sql: select m.member_id, m.repository_id, m.user_id, m.role, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.email from sys_git_repository_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_git_repository_member where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and role = 'admin'
select count(1) from sys_git_repository_member m inner join sys_git_repository r on r.repository_id = m.repository_id where r.project_id = #{projectId} and m.user_id = #{userId}

select min(m.member_id) as member_id, null as repository_id, m.user_id as user_id, case min(case m.role when 'admin' then 0 when 'write' then 1 else 2 end) when 0 then 'admin' when 1 then 'write' else 'read' end as role, null as create_by, null as create_time, null as update_by, null as update_time, null as remark, u.user_name as user_name, u.nick_name as nick_name, u.avatar as avatar, u.email as email from sys_git_repository_member m inner join sys_git_repository r on r.repository_id = m.repository_id inner join sys_project p on r.project_id = p.project_id and p.project_state > 0 left join sys_user u on u.user_id = m.user_id where r.project_id = #{projectId} group by m.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.avatar, u.email order by min(case m.role when 'admin' then 0 when 'write' then 1 else 2 end), min(m.member_id)
mapper.delete: delete from sys_git_repository_member where repository_id = #{repositoryId} and user_id = #{userId}
